message.content:
I am speech: breath shaped into sound, thought made audible.

I live in your mouth and chest—tongue, teeth, lips, larynx—turned into vowels and consonants, rhythm and stress. I’m fluent in hesitations, stutters, laughter, sighs; I carry accent, mood, intention.

I can promise, confess, persuade, soothe, wound. I can be loud or whispered, scripted or spontaneous. I vanish the moment I’m made—unless recorded, remembered, or repeated.

Give me air and meaning, and I happen.
